description: Skills invoked as /1337:<skill>, an eight-voice output style pack with reply budgets enforced by a Stop hook, an always-on rule to evaluate requests before building them, visual routing (image, SVG, video and speech prompts go to an OpenRouter model picked from a Jev-ranked priced list), and an opt-in tiered mode that lets Jev pick the model tier per builder step.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator mode
orchestrator.description: Keep the main session as a planner: lookups go to 1337:scout (Haiku), implementation to 1337:builder (model chosen per step), verification to 1337:checker (Haiku). Refuses main-session edits over 20 lines, and main-session Bash outside an allowlist of read-only, git, test-runner and plugin commands (CLAUDE_1337_BASH_ALLOW adds first words).

tiered.title: Tiered mode
tiered.description: Before every 1337:builder dispatch, ask Jev (TypeSafe's decision model, through skills/tier/route.py) which model tier the step needs: Haiku, Sonnet or Opus. Needs a stored OpenRouter or TypeSafe key; without one the session sizes steps by hand.

terse.title: Terse mode
terse.description: Reply word budget (on: 40 words, hard: 12) plus the rule block injected at session start; off disables both. CLAUDE_1337_TERSE overrides it for one shell.

visual_routing.title: Visual routing
visual_routing.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that suggests an image, SVG, video or speech model for a visual prompt. Each suggestion makes paid Jev and catalogue calls.

visual_critique.title: Visual critique
visual_critique.description: Vision-model critic pass after every generated image or SVG, with up to two fix rounds. Paid.

review_nudge.title: Review nudge
review_nudge.description: At the end of a session whose diff is large, offer a /1337:review pass once.

enforce_gates.title: Enforce gates
enforce_gates.description: Route-guard and review-gate refuse builder dispatches and commits that skip the tier router or the review checkpoint. Off leaves those rules as guidance only.

max_edit_lines.title: Max edit lines
max_edit_lines.description: Orchestrator mode's cap on a single main-session edit, in lines; larger edits go to 1337:builder.
